deviation: The draft's 5.3 has a monthly governance review but doesn't require a written monthly report. It also leaves out reporting against service levels (it covers Milestones, risks, issues and change requests instead). Arcadia could lose a regular, documented record of service-level performance, which it needs to enforce service credits and remedies. The weekly steering committee is extra and does no harm, but it doesn't make up for the missing report.
suggested_text: 5.3 Governance. The parties shall hold a monthly service review meeting, and the Supplier shall provide a written monthly report of progress against Milestones and service levels. The Supplier shall circulate agendas in advance and minutes and action logs afterwards, and the monthly report shall also cover risks, issues and change requests. [Optional: The Supplier shall also hold a weekly steering committee during the implementation phase.] Clauses 5.1 and 5.2 may remain as drafted.
